title: Find or add a client
summary: Keep one useful client record and avoid accidental duplicates.

sections.title: Find someone already in your directory
sections.body:
Open **Clients**. Use **Search clients** with a name, or a phone number or email if your role allows contact access. Choose a client to open their profile. Use relationship or preferred-staff filters and **Sort clients** to focus the directory; clear search and filters if a person seems missing.

Personal-calendar access can limit you to clients connected to your own visits and assigned locations. A missing contact field can be an access restriction, rather than missing data.

sections.title: Create a client
sections.body:
1. Select **Add client**.
2. Enter required **Full name** and provide a **Mobile number** or **Email** so the person can be identified.
3. Review any **Review an existing client first** matches.
4. Open the existing profile if it is the same person. Select **This is a different person sharing these contact details** only after confirming they really are different people.
5. Optionally expand **Referral source** and enter **How they found you**.
6. Select **Add client** and check the resulting profile.

An exact name and contact match opens the existing profile. ClipperDesk does not automatically merge different people who share contact information.

sections.title: After adding
sections.body:
Use **Edit profile** for preferences, tags and additional details, or **Book appointment** to start a visit. A new profile does not subscribe the client to marketing or prove SMS consent.

If the client already exists, choose that record in Calendar or Walk-in queue. Reusing the record keeps visits, notes and payment history together.
